# Marc Cycling

> Mobile bicycle and e-bike repair service in Broward County and South Florida, USA. The mechanic comes to the customer's home or office. Service-area business, no retail store.

- Website: https://marccycling.com
- Booking (Saturdays and Sundays, 7am to 5pm ET): https://marccycling.com/book/
- Phone and WhatsApp: +1 (754) 252-5245
- Languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish
- Rating: 5.0 on Google (over 100 reviews, as of July 2026), see https://g.page/marccycling

## Services and prices (labor only, parts not included; prices updated July 2026)

- Flat tire, standard bike: $49 + tube (tubes run $24 to $40)
- Flat tire, e-bike: $120 + tube
- Bronze tune-up: from $95 (35-point safety inspection, chain lube, tire pressure, bolt check)
- Silver tune-up: from $140 (Bronze + derailleur and brake adjustment, wheel truing, test ride)
- Gold tune-up: from $215 (Silver + full wash, drivetrain degrease, bearing check, frame polish)
- E-Bike Silver: from $150
- E-Bike Gold: from $220

## Service area

Broward County and South Florida: Fort Lauderdale, Hollywood, Pembroke Pines, Pompano Beach, Coral Springs, Davie, Plantation, Sunrise, Weston, Miramar, Coconut Creek, Miami and Doral.

## Trip fee and cancellation

Free estimates by phone, always. When you book the service, there is no trip fee. You pay for the work only. The $75 trip charge applies in one case only: if we come out, give you the price, and you decide not to do the work. There is no fee to cancel or reschedule an appointment; a no-show (a reservation that was not canceled) counts as a declined visit and the $75 trip charge applies.

## Payment

Zelle, Venmo, Apple Pay, checks and cash. No credit cards.

## Notes

- All e-bike work is mechanical (brakes, gears, tires, wheels, drivetrain, tune-ups, battery charge check). Internal battery and motor repairs, wiring faults and motor conversion kits are outside the service scope.
- Responsible mechanic: Caetano Marc Zammataro ("Marc"), working on bikes since 2005.
- Factory certifications (originals published at https://marccycling.com/#credentials): Trek & Bosch E-Bike Systems Training (2018), Shimano Service Center (2013), Shimano Di2/STEPS/XTR Mechanics Training (2019), SRAM & RockShox Authorized Service (2019), Specialized SBCU Retul Level One (2021), Retul University Custom Fit (2013), bikefitting.com Static Fit Level 1 (2018), Trek Precision Fit Technician (2011), Elite Technical Training (2019), Park Tool Certified Mechanic (Park Tool Brasil). Shimano and Park Tool certified mechanic, working on bikes since 2005.
- Workmanship guaranteed: if something isn't right after a service, contact within 15 days and it is made right at no charge.
- Customers are welcome to watch the service. Before the visit: keep the bike accessible; for e-bikes, have the battery charged for post-service testing.
